title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
abstract: arXiv:2608.01035v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving; however, their efficient deployment is severely constrained by high computational latency and exposure bias arising from sequential autoregressive decoding. Conversely, while specialized diffusion policies enable low-latency, parallel execution, training them from scratch typically yields narrow, single-task architectures that lack holistic visual-linguistic reasoning. Successfully transforming pre-trained autoregressive generalists into parallel diffusion models could combine multi-task cognitive intelligence with execution efficiency, yet this transition presents a formidable architectural challenge due to mismatched attention patterns (causal versus bidirectional) and divergent optimization objectives. translated_title: WAM-Diff2：面向高效自动驾驶VLA的分层自回归到扩散蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01035v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为端到端自动驾驶的突出范式；然而，其高效部署受到高计算延迟和由顺序自回归解码引起的暴露偏差的严重限制。相反，尽管专门的扩散策略能够实现低延迟并行执行，但从零训练这些策略通常会产生狭窄的单任务架构，缺乏整体的视觉-语言推理能力。成功将预训练的自回归通才模型转化为并行扩散模型，可以结合多任务认知智能与执行效率，但由于注意力模式（因果注意力与双向注意力）不匹配和优化目标发散，这种转变面临巨大的架构挑战。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们引入了WAM-Diff2，一种由三阶段驱动的多任务离散扩散VLA框架。
tldr: WAM-Diff2通过三阶段蒸馏方法，将预训练的自回归VLA模型高效转化为多任务离散扩散模型，解决了注意力模式不匹配和优化目标分歧问题，实现了低延迟并行执行与多任务认知智能的统一。
en_tdlr: WAM-Diff2 employs a three-stage distillation approach to efficiently transform pre-trained autoregressive VLA models into multi-task discrete diffusion models, resolving attention pattern mismatches and divergent optimization objectives to unify low-latency parallel execution with multi-task cognitive intelligence.
